entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: 1Ch 22:1-5 . David Prepares for Building the Temple.

entries.heading: 2. David commanded to gather together the strangers
entries.text: 2. David commanded to gather together the strangers --partly the descendants of the old Canaanites ( 2Ch 8:7-10 ), from whom was exacted a tribute of bond service, and partly war captives ( 2Ch 2:7 ), reserved for the great work he contemplated.
